MDWC_Adrenaline.description.english: Adrenaline in the bloodstream. It dulls pain and quickens movement and thought, then fades into a long, sluggish crash. The body tires faster and faster as it wears off.

MDWC_WarcasketHelmet_Medic.description.english:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, fitted with a medical assist and a diagnostic visor that lets the mechanite dressing treat disease and infection as well as wounds.

A 10th-generation design from the government program that rebuilt captured pirate rigs around its own power armor and gave them to veterans who could no longer serve any other way. The Medic was its rig for the surgeons who had served beside them.

The shell's dressing suite tends a squadmate's wounds where they fall, the pauldrons' injector keeps them on their feet a while longer, and the helmet's visor diagnoses what no bandage treats. Plating and shield are the generation's standard, so a Medic fights a step behind the line, and a squad that fields one holds out long after its bandages run out.

MDWC_WarcasketTrait_Medic.degreeDatas.wa.english:
{PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. Pain has no effect on {PAWN_objective}, and {PAWN_pronoun} can never go into pain shock or drop unconscious from it.

Built for treating the wounded, the suit leaves {PAWN_objective} free to doctor, but it is too bulky for most other work.

MDWC_AdrenalineShot.description.english: Inject a nearby person or animal with a dose of adrenaline. For a short while they feel almost no pain and move and think faster. A long crash follows, leaving them dull and slow for hours, and they tire faster throughout. On a patient with a heart attack the shot is spent on the heart instead.

MDWC_MechaniteDressing.description.english: Stream medicine-laden mechanites onto a nearby person or animal to tend their wounds on the spot, worst first. Tend quality depends on the pilot's medical skill and the medicine used, and the skill sets the pace. With the medic helmet worn, it treats diseases and infections too.
